title: Ground of the Overturn: Units on the Authorization After a Successful Quantity Appeal
content:
On the authorization owed after a Member Appeals Program appeal overturns a quantity limit denial on an acute migraine drug under the Utilization Management Program, the ground of the overturn adds units to the overturn ceiling.

| Ground recorded on the overturned appeal | Units added |
|---|---|
| overturned on new information | 2 |
| overturned because the criteria were met on appeal | 1 |
| any other ground | 0 |

The ground read is the decision reason of the member's most recent overturned appeal of a coverage review denial.

*Hypothetical cases:* the member's latest overturned appeal records new information as its ground — 2 units; it records that the criteria were met on appeal — 1 unit; an appeal overturned on any other recorded ground — no units.
